bio.text: Robin Bartleman represents District 103 in the Florida House of Representatives, elected in 2020.
Bartleman served on the Broward County School Board from 2004 to 2020 and was a Weston city commissioner from 2000 to 2004.
Bartleman is an assistant principal and special education teacher from Weston, with degrees from Florida International University (1994) and Nova Southeastern University (1997).
